newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Celesc started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Celesc started as buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said it initiated coverage of Brazilian power firm Centrais Eletricas Santa Catarina (Celesc) with a buy recommendation.
-- It said strong earnings growth from Celesc's core distribution business, generation expansion, and low debt levels make it one of the best buys in the Brazilian power sector.

-- Caspian also said that at a current price of $873 per 1,000 shares, Celesc continues to be attractively valued. -- Celesc preferred shares traded at 0.94 reais, up 6.8 percent from Thursday's close, at 1525 local/1825 GMT on the Sao Paulo bourse.
